meadow-welcome: Welcome to the Weather Observatory! Tap play and watch the meadow change.
meadow-sun-prompt: First, tap the sun to warm the meadow.
meadow-sun-result: Sunlight warms the earth. Look—the little bud is waking up!
meadow-rain-prompt: Now tap rain to give the flower a drink.
meadow-rain-result: Rain soaks into the soil. The flower is growing!
meadow-wind-prompt: Slide the wind dial and help the leaves dance.
meadow-wind-result: Whoosh! Wind pushes clouds and carries leaves through the sky.
meadow-cloud-prompt: Tap the cloud to make cool shade.
meadow-cloud-result: Clouds cover some sunlight and make a patch of shade.
meadow-wind-nudge: Slide the golden dial toward the dancing leaves.
meadow-complete: You did it! Sun, rain, wind, and clouds all change the meadow. You’re a Weather Scientist!
meadow-free-lab: Now make your own weather. What happens when two kinds of weather meet?
meadow-rainbow: Sun and rain together made a rainbow!
meadow-reset: The observatory is ready for another weather day.
